title: Action Plan
description: Unified execution plan schema. JSON is the source of truth for TODO state, implementation progress, and verification references per action item. A plan may reference zero or more PRs via pr_attributes[]; project-scoped plans (research, refactor, incident) may omit pr_attributes entirely.

plan_id.description: Zero-padded 4-digit sequential plan number. Counts up within docs/PLANS/. Also enforced as the filename prefix: docs/PLANS/{plan_id}_{Title}_ActionPlan.json and docs/PLANS/{plan_id}_{Title}_PIP.md.

completed.description: Date all items reached a terminal status (COMPLETE or CLOSED_NO_ACTION). Null while the plan is in progress.

source_document.description: Path or reference to the source document (issue, spec, ticket, research note). Per-PR review documents live in pr_attributes[].review_doc instead.

documentation.description: Optional path to a detailed implementation plan or design document (e.g., docs/PLANS/{plan_id}_{Title}_PIP.md)

branch.description: Primary working branch if the plan has a single-branch shape. Per-PR branches go in pr_attributes[].branch.

base_branch.description: Primary target branch if the plan has a single-branch shape. Per-PR base branches go in pr_attributes[].base_branch.

execution_model.description: How work is organized (e.g., 'serial', 'parallel (3 worktrees: A=CI, B=workflow, C=tests)', 'staged (phase 1, 2, 3)')

markdown_sync_status.description: Optional JSON->Markdown sync marker. Use pending_markdown_sync when JSON moved ahead; Markdown must be brought in sync before branch close.

markdown_last_updated.description: Date when companion Markdown sections were last synchronized with this JSON plan.

context.description: Optional metadata about the plan context

pr_attributes.description: Zero or more PR associations for this plan. Empty/omit for project-scoped plans.

items.description: Array of action items, one per issue/task

deferred_to_future_plans.description: Optional log of scope deferrals - what was considered and explicitly pushed out of this plan.

id.description: Item identifier: 2-4 uppercase letters + '-' + digits/periods (e.g., 'CRS-1', 'TASK-3.2', 'BUG-789'). Priority/severity is carried in the separate priority field, not encoded in the ID.

worktree.description: Parallel work unit if applicable. Free string - the schema doesn't enforce a specific vocabulary (e.g., 'A', 'B', 'phase-1', 'service-x', null).

action.description: TODO implementation steps in concise, execution-ready form. Keep this as source-of-truth checklist content.

files.description: Paths to files modified to resolve this item (empty array if no changes). Entries should be pure paths - put clarifying notes in the notes field, not embedded in path strings.

dependencies.description: Item IDs that must be completed before this one (null if none)

status.description: Current status. Never set without corresponding evidence. BLOCKED captures 'cannot proceed until X' with rationale in evidence.

evidence.description: Current reality claim (what is COMPLETE, IN_PROGRESS, BLOCKED, or CLOSED_NO_ACTION). Keep concise; put durable proof pointers in verification_references.

verification_references.description: Durable references that verify the current status (git tree SHAs, test commands, CI run links, artifact paths, or doc anchors).

markdown_section.description: Companion Markdown section key/anchor that expands this item (e.g., 'FCC-1', '#task-fcc-1', or docs/PLANS/...#fcc-1).

notes.description: Optional additional context, decision rationale, or legacy ID mapping (e.g., 'Was C1 in pre-unification schema')
